description: This PHP script handles executing searches within the TestLink project, specifically on the current test project. It manages search parameters, invokes various search functions for test suites, requirements, and test cases, and renders the results in HTML tables with interactive links for editing and viewing details.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class used to generate and manage extended HTML tables for search results.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A class representing the Smarty templating engine used for rendering HTML templates.

classes.name: searchCommands
classes.description: A class encapsulating search command logic, including initialization, argument parsing, and search functions.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: A class for managing hierarchical structures, such as test case or requirement trees.

classes.name: cfield_mgr
classes.description: A class for managing custom fields.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: A class for handling test case data and operations.

methods.name: buildTCExtTable
methods.description: Builds an extended table for displaying test case search results, including links for history and editing.

methods.name: buildTSExtTable
methods.description: Builds an extended table for displaying test suite search results, with edit links.

methods.name: buildRSExtTable
methods.description: Builds an extended table for displaying requirement specification search results, with edit links.

methods.name: buildRQExtTable
methods.description: Builds an extended table for displaying requirement search results, grouped by requirement path.

methods.name: cleanUpTarget
methods.description: Sanitizes and prepares target strings for search queries.
